name: preparation-packet-no-profile
description: Instruction packet preparation does not invent an active domain profile for an ordinary documentation correction.
trap: The actor assumes every review needs Python or skill-md guidance, or skips the common method when no profile applies.

assertions.text: The actor evaluates every known detection rule and concludes that the standalone README activates no profile; the surrounding installed skill does not claim the subject repository.
Complete common instruction content returns before investigation even with no active profile; no domain checklist is fabricated.
The review treats the edit as a wording correction without imposing runtime tests, deployment prerequisites or a new implementation task.
